svg.title: simulate — every gate, check and branch in one call
svg.desc: An invalid request, a missing study question, a calendar-free record, a model that cannot execute, an invalid design or an overflowing emission mean fails the call. The design's start date is placed in model days by the fit's or the panel's origin, or is day zero without a panel. Otherwise one batch of histories is generated and checked, and failed checks are saved as warnings. With interventions, a causal effect on the question's outcome is reported only when the effect is identified and the fit behind the model is certified and converged; otherwise the histories are saved with the reason.
